snippet.title: Project M.E.D.S. Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Project M.E.D.S. is out now in Early Access: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4747520/PROJECT_MEDS/

The body is under attack. Fight hordes of germs as a pill, unlock medical weapons and collect lost pages from medical books to build powerful runs in this survival roguelite set inside the human body.
